sources.note: Main homepage. Describes cloud-based EHR & billing for rural hospitals and ambulatory clinics. Highlights AI Clinical Assistant, AI Billing Assistant, and Analytics. Testimonials from Reeves Memorial Medical Center and Gabbert Medical.
ONC certification page. Lists two certified products: Azalea EHR 4.0 (CHPL 11151) and ChartAccess 7.0 (CHPL 11140). Links to cost disclosures, real world testing, and MFA use cases.
Ambulatory EHR product page. Describes practice management integration, cloud-based EHR, RCM services. Claims 37% faster than 12 other leading ambulatory EHRs.
Hospital EHR product page. Targets rural and critical access hospitals under 100 beds. Describes unified patient record across inpatient, ED, and clinics. Integrated clinical and financial workflows.
Patient portal (myHealthspot) page. Features: view health records, request appointments, pay bills online, update demographics/insurance, request refills, secure messaging with providers.
Telehealth product page. HIPAA-compliant video visits integrated into EHR platform. Provider-to-provider and provider-to-patient. Visits automatically saved to patient record.
AI features page. Clinical Assistant powered by Suki for ambient charting and voice transcription. Billing Assistant for automated coding error detection and claim status tracking.
Analytics product page. Enterprise Data Warehouse, KPI/CQM dashboards, financial/operational/clinical analytics. Integrates with legacy EHR systems. MIPS/MACRA and population health reporting.
Practice management page. Scheduling, claims, payment posting, multi-location management. Company started as a billing company.

Third-party review aggregator. Confirms focus on rural hospitals and clinics. Mentions pros: user-friendly, integrated telehealth, all-in-one system. Cons: limited customizability, occasional downtimes.
Third-party review. Describes AI billing and telehealth features. Confirms target market of rural and community healthcare providers.
2017 press release about merger with Prognosis Innovation Healthcare. Added ~40 hospitals. Created combined hospital + ambulatory platform for rural market.
BusinessWire coverage of October 2017 Azalea-Prognosis merger. Second major acquisition in 2017 for Azalea.
Azalea Health company brochure. Reports 300,000+ unique users, 15,000 providers, 20M+ patients served.
Company profile. Estimates ~$56.5M annual revenue and ~300 employees.
